create_pass_through_route: create a FastAPI route handler that proxies HTTP requests to a target URL with custom headers and query params
build_pass_through_request: build an async HTTP pass-through request that forwards to a target URL with streaming, guardrails, and litellm logging
run_initialize_pass_through_endpoints: run initialization of pass-through endpoints from DB and config into the FastAPI proxy server
test_add_exact_path_route: test adding an exact path route to a FastAPI app with deduplication and method filtering
run_websocket_passthrough_request: run a bidirectional WebSocket passthrough that forwards messages between client and upstream target
